workflows.name: Smartsheet Scheduled Order Sync
workflows.description: Runs every 15 minutes server-side, offset 8 minutes after the Sales Pipeline sync so the two pipelines do not compete for the Smartsheet read budget. Order Form follows its enabled pull/push directions: pull may create Base44 Orders from new verified Smartsheet rows; push writes only Orders durably marked for sync and may create a linked Smartsheet row for a new pending Order when creation is enabled. Save & Sync remains available for immediate explicit writes. Only runs when global sync is enabled and observation mode is off.

workflows.name: Permitting Research Backlog Refill
workflows.description: Runs every 15 minutes and invokes the cost-controlled permitting research dispatcher. Runtime admin settings can pause dispatch, reduce batch size, cap active research, or impose a daily release limit without shrinking the statewide backlog.

workflows.name: Permitting Operational Alerts
workflows.description: Deduped operational automations: missing-document warnings for PermitLineItems whose locality has verified requirements. Respects existing WorkOrder/PermitLineItem semantics — recommends, never rewrites active permit processes.

workflows.name: Source Monitor Scan
workflows.description: Cheap programmatic source monitoring: fetches monitored source URLs and compares hash/headers. AI is only invoked when a change is detected. Flags affected approved rules for re-review and creates deduped alerts. Never erases archives or auto-promotes drafts.

workflows.name: Time Clock Stale Shift Monitor
workflows.description: Hourly Time Clock stale-shift detection. Creates an auditable open Punch Exception after the existing 18-hour cross-date threshold without changing any punch time.

workflows.name: Smartsheet Scheduled Sales Sync
workflows.description: Runs every 15 minutes server-side. Sales Pipeline follows its enabled pull/push directions and reports to its own smartsheetSalesSyncStatus coordinator. Order Form sync runs separately on its own schedule. Only runs when global sync is enabled and observation mode is off.

workflows.name: Fleet Bouncie Alert Sync
workflows.description: Evaluates CCS-local Fleet alert thresholds from Bouncie vehicle stats every 5 minutes. Uses durable per-vehicle runtime state so persistent threshold breaches do not create repeated alerts. Does not modify Bouncie-owned settings or webhooks.

workflows.name: Fleet Scheduled Maintenance Generation
workflows.description: Checks due Fleet maintenance schedules every morning at 6:45am Eastern. Safe before cutover because FleetSettings.maintenance_generation_enabled defaults to false.

workflows.name: Fleet Scheduled Reminders
workflows.description: Production Fleet reminder digest check at 7:00 AM Eastern. Server-gated by FleetCutoverState and idempotent per recipient/day; the notification worker provides a configured-day fallback after 7:10 AM if the primary heartbeat is absent.

workflows.name: Fleet Notification Queue Worker
workflows.description: Processes due Fleet email notifications every 10 minutes. Safe before cutover because FleetSettings.notifications_enabled defaults to false.

workflows.name: Permit Follow-up Reminders
workflows.description: Daily scan of permit line items — fires permit_followup_due / permit_followup_overdue automation triggers based on next_followup_date.

workflows.name: Weekly Jurisdiction Accuracy Audit
workflows.description: AI cross-references jurisdiction data against official government sources weekly and flags potential inaccuracies for review

workflows.name: Daily Jurisdiction Regulation Monitoring
workflows.description: Automatically monitor all jurisdictions for regulation changes and send alerts to users"

workflows.name: Process CoreBridge Emails
workflows.description: Checks Gmail every 10 minutes for CoreBridge estimate/invoice emails and auto-creates or updates work orders in the Sales Pipeline

workflows.name: Daily Deadline Reminder Check
workflows.description: Checks for approaching and overdue deadlines daily at 8am and triggers notifications

workflows.name: Scheduled Google Drive Backup
workflows.description: Runs daily backup to Google Drive at 2am
